policy._mode_help: approve = auto-pick allow/allow-always. classify = ask local model first. off = detect+log only (never press).

keystroke._numberedMenu_help: digitOnly = press the option number (Claude Code style). digitEnter = press number then Enter (classic menus).

classifier._fallback_help: skip = leave prompt for human if model unreachable. allow = approve anyway. deny = press No.
